She tucked the note into her coat, beside the logbook, and climbed back up to tend the light.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市睡得最沉。街道空旷无人，路灯把梧桐的影子拉得很长。一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，水痕在柏油路上泛着微光；早点铺升起第一缕蒸汽，与夜班归人的哈气缠在一起。高楼的窗口零星亮着，像不肯熄灭的星。首班地铁从远处传来低鸣，这座城市在黑暗与黎明的交界处，悄悄翻了个身。", "w03": "• A recursive function solves a big problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.\n• Imagine Russian nesting dolls: you keep opening dolls until you reach the tiny one that doesn't open — that's the base case, where the process stops.\n• Then everything closes back up in reverse order, with each step using the answer from the step inside it."}
